The result is that the needs of each individual take priority in the life of the family. Moreover, there is less emphasis on the family as an economic unit because the American family is rarely self-supporting. Relatively few families maintain self-supporting family farms or businesses for more than one generation. A farmer’s son, for example, is very likely to go on to college, leave the family farm, and take an entirely different job in a different location. [3]The American desire for freedom from outside control clearly extends to the family. Americans do not like to have controls placed on them by other family members. They want to make independent decisions and not be told what to do by grandparents or uncles or aunts. For example, both American men and women expect to decide what job is best for them as individuals. Indeed, young Americans are encouraged by their families to make such independent career decisions. (Total 4 minutes) The narration of every section needs over 6 sentences. --------------------------------------------------------------------------- Section 1: During Class Section 2: During Lunch Time Section 3: Club Activity & Extra Classes Section 4: During Vacation [예시답안] [Narration for Making a V-log(Video+Blog)] Section Narration During Class In Korea, teachers hold most classes where teachers only teach and students only listen. However, in American school, teachers hold classes where students can also be a teacher. In some classes, teachers even assign students to research about a particular topic, and ask them to teach the whole class what they have researched about. In that way, teachers can both be a student and  teacher, which improves participation of both teachers and students during class. Also, in American class, there is more discussion between teachers and students. In our American school, we even had a couch where students and teachers can sit around together and have a group discussion or do a class activities. During Lunch Time In our American school, we had a large cafeteria with a small sandwich store, pizza store, salad corner, and hot lunch corner. Whereas in Korea, schools provide the same menu to all the students. My America school’s cafeteria also had a large library right above, and there was some field and courts around the cafeteria. There was even a court for a game named ‘4 Square’. In this way, students could play various sports, or go up to the library and read books as soon as they were done eating. We had our main building closed during the lunch time, which made more students play sports rather than studying. Club Activity & Extra Classes In American school, extra classes were mostly related to crafting things, and students both had choices on joining the club activities and extra classes. However, in Korea, many of the extra classes are related to learning and studying, and for the club activities, there are lots of choices, but you have to pick only one. During Vacation American school has much more vacation days than Korea. In Korea, there are only about 3 months of vacation, whereas American school holds about 5 months of vacation. In Korea, most students would study, go to academies, or attend extra classes of the school during their vacation. However, in American school most students would travel to other countries. In my case, almost the whole town was empty with so many people traveling to other places. That is, Korean students spend their vacation for learning and studying, while American students spend their vacation for gaining various experiences.
